entries.create_connected.ponder.inventory_access: Connecting to inventories with Inventory Access Port
Accessing inventory can be challenging in tight spaces
Inventory Access Ports extend inventories to help with that
Multiple ports can be attached to one inventory
Ports do not provide additional storage space
But components attached to ports can access inventories...
But they can be disabled with redstone
entries.create_connected.ponder.inventory_bridge: Connecting two inventories with Inventory Bridge
Inventory Bridge provides an interface to access two inventories simultaneously
It does not provide additional storage space
Only components attached to the bridge itself can access both inventories
Multiple bridges can be attached to the same set of inventories
Use a redstone signal to disable the bridge
Filter slots on the Inventory Bridge specify which inventory the inserted items should go to
Items that do not match either filter cannot be inserted into the bridge
Non-empty filters take precedence over empty ones...
...and prevent matching items from going to the unfiltered side
Filters are also respected when extracting items from inventories...
...and an empty filter rejects items that match the other side
Items rejected by filters are not visible in stock link networks

entries.create_enchantment_industry.ponder.blaze: Automating with Mechanical Arms
In Extract Mode, two input Depots provide affixed equipment and a blank template
The input Arm recognizes each item's role for the selected mode and inserts it into the correct slot
Until both outputs are removed, neither the Arm nor a player can begin another batch
The output Arm extracts the stripped equipment and the filled template one after the other
Arms can also insert Apotheotic Essence containers and the Super activator; use a bottom pipe for continuous fluid supply
Introduction to Blaze Composer
The Blaze Composer transfers, combines, and reapplies Apotheosis affixes
Different affixes can also be collected together on the resulting template
Apply Mode consumes the template and adds or upgrades every compatible affix on the target equipment
Every output must be removed before the Composer will accept the next batch
Supply Apotheotic Essence through the bottom to activate Normal Mode
Normal Mode accepts Brass and Crystal Affix Templates; each tier has its own level capacity
Use the side panel to select Extract Mode...
...Merge Mode...
...or Apply Mode
Engineer's Goggles preview the required inputs, essence cost, result, and any reason an operation cannot start
Extract Mode moves one affix from equipment to a matching blank template and returns the equipment without that affix
Merge Mode combines templates of the same tier and rarity; two matching level 0.25 affixes produce level 0.5
Super Composing with Blaze Composer
Fill the Normal tank through the bottom pipe, then give the Composer a Godforged Pearl to permanently unlock its second tank
Keep the bottom pipe supplied after the unlock; once the Normal tank is full, more Apotheotic Essence flows into the second tank and activates Super Mode
Super Mode accepts only Apotheotic Affix Templates, which can carry levels beyond an affix's native limit
Actual level limits and essence costs follow server configuration; check them with Engineer's Goggles
With a clear path to the sky, an exposed nearby Lightning Rod safely redirects the strike with no penalty
Blocking the strike path prevents lightning, but the result randomly loses affix levels; Goggles show the possible loss range
With a clear sky but no Lightning Rod, the strike destroys the Composer before it can finish
Automating with Mechanical Arm
Blaze Enchanter can be automated with Mechanical Arm
Mechanical Arm can insert item for enchanting
Mechanical Arm also can feed experience fuel
Mechanical Arm can extract enchanted item and invalid item
Introduction to Blaze Enchanter
This is a Blaze Enchanter, which functions like an Enchanting Table
Because golden chest armor has better enchantability compared to diamond chest armor, it produces relatively better enchantments
However, higher Enchanting Level is not always better. Some enchantments will not appear when the Enchanting Level is too high!
Provide it Liquid Experience to activate it
Before enchanting with it, the enchant level must be set via the panel. The level cap of a vanilla enchanting table is 30
The panel is also a filter slot. Right click that slot with an item to designate that item as a template. This state is called Template Enchanting Mode
In Template Enchanting Mode, Blaze Enchanter can enchant Enchanting Template
Template Enchanting Mode is used to produce only enchantments supported by the template item
For example, placing diamond chest armor in the filter slot causes only diamond-chest-armor enchantments to be generated
Give a blank Enchanting Template to Blaze Enchanter, and the aforementioned enchantments will be added to it
Different materials and template item types will produce different enchantments
Super Enchanting with Blaze Enchanter
The Blaze Enchanter has two "stomachs". Feed it a Cake o' Enchanting...
...and it will begin seething. This state is known as Super Enchanting mode
The second tank of Blaze Enchanter can not be piped in for Liquid Experience. An eligible Super Experience item, such as Cake o' Enchanting, must be used
While in Super Enchanting mode, the enchant level cap is significantly increased. Additionally, the Enchanter can now produce Treasure Enchantments
Blaze Enchanter in Super Enchanting mode exclusively processes Super Enchanting Templates
Make sure to place a Lightning Rod nearby
Super Enchanting can cause lightning strikes
You can cover the Blaze Enchanter with block to avoid lightning strikes, but then curse may appear
If no Lightning Rods are present...
Automating with Mechanical Arm
Blaze Forger can be automated with Mechanical Arm
Mechanical Arm can insert item for forging
Mechanical Arm also can feed experience fuel
Mechanical Arm can extract forged item and invalid item
Introduction to Blaze Forger
This is a Blaze Forger, which functions like an Anvil
Provide it Liquid Experience to activate it
Blaze Forger can merge enchantments of the same item like an anvil, but with no Repair Cost
Blaze Forger can also merge Enchanting Templates
Work Mode can be changed via side panel
Switch Blaze Forger to Application Mode, and it can apply Enchanting Templates to items!
Switch it to Extract Mode, and it can strip an enchantment from equipment, books or templates into a blank Enchanting Template!
Super Enchanting with Blaze Forger
The Blaze Forger has two "stomachs". Feed it a Cake o' Enchanting...
...and it will begin seething, and enter Super Enchanting mode
The second tank of Blaze Forger can not be piped in for Liquid Experience. An eligible Super Experience item, such as Cake o' Enchanting, must be used
While in Super Enchanting mode, Blaze Forger can surpass the vanilla enchantment level cap while merging enchantments. Conflicting enchantments can also be merged together
Blaze Forger in Super Enchanting mode exclusively processes and applies Super Enchanting Templates
Make sure to place a Lightning Rod nearby
Super Enchanting can cause lightning strikes
You can cover the Blaze Forger with a block to avoid lightning strikes, but this may introduce Repair Cost
If no Lightning Rods are present...

Storing kinetic stress with Kinetic Battery
The Kinetic Battery stores stress units for future use
When unpowered, it consumes kinetic stress from the front to charge up
When powered by redstone, it discharges by generating a set amount of stress capacity at a fixed speed
But the amount of battery charge consumed depends on the actual amount of stress capacity in use
When other kinetic sources provide enough stress capacity, batteries will not discharge
Even if the network has zero stress impact, batteries still consume a tiny amount of charge to drive belts for item transport
A comparator can be used to read the current battery level
Use a Threshold Switch for a more accurate reading
Or use a Display Link to display battery level
entries.create_connected.ponder.kinetic_battery_: Batteries retain their charge in item form
When a battery is discharging, right click with a charged battery to recharge
When a battery is in charging mode, right click with another battery to discharge
Deployers and mechanical arms can automate the energy transfer
The Kinetic Battery has a rear output...
which is coupled to the front input when it finishes charging/discharging...
but is disconnected when the battery is operating
This allows you to chain batteries to extend the discharge duration
When one battery receives a redstone signal, all batteries in the chain get powered
To increase the total stress capacity, connect batteries in parallel instead

entries.createsprings.ponder.catapult.text_5: Items placed in the catapult cause it to trigger
entries.createsprings.ponder.catapult.text_6: Supply Rotational Force in order to charge it
entries.createsprings.ponder.catapult_second_tar: Sneak and Right-Click holding an Spring Catapult to select its main target
Sneak and Right-Click Two times to select its second target
After receiving or shooting items catapult will switch targets
entries.createsprings.ponder.explosion.text_1: When an explosion occurs near the spring, spring receives some charge
entries.createsprings.ponder.explosion.text_2: if spring doesn't face the explosion, it explodes
entries.createsprings.ponder.explosion.text_3: spring can be charged even by explosions in water
entries.createsprings.ponder.kinetic_interface.t: Springs on contraptions can be tricky to access
This component can interact with springs without the need to stop the contraption
Place a second one with a gap of a block inbetween
While engaged, the stationary interface will represent ALL springs and large springs on the contraption
If stationary interface is rotating, springs on contraption will charge
If stationary interface is powered it will generate energy using charge of the springs on the contraption
entries.createsprings.ponder.large_spring.text_1: To construct large spring place a 3*3 square of Large Spring Coils
entries.createsprings.ponder.large_spring.text_2: All placed coils should face the same direction
entries.createsprings.ponder.large_spring.text_3: Add hollow rings of coils to make spring longer
if any block in the spring is powered large spring will start releasing stored energy
Speed of generated rotation depends on the signal strength
Large spring mode can be switched by clicking with tripwire hook to the center of the first layer
entries.createsprings.ponder.spring.text_1: Springs are able to store rotational force
entries.createsprings.ponder.spring.text_2: The direction of rotation does not matter
entries.createsprings.ponder.spring.text_3: When powered, the spring will slowly release stored energy
entries.createsprings.ponder.spring.text_4: The speed of generated rotation depends on signal strength
entries.createsprings.ponder.spring.text_5: The charging rate can be changed by configuring spring stiffness
entries.createsprings.ponder.spring.text_6: By default spring adapts it's stiffness in order to maximise efficiency
entries.createsprings.ponder.spring_sable.text_1: that content is available only if Sable(Create Aeronautics) is installed
entries.createsprings.ponder.spring_sable.text_2: in splash mode springs are able to push sub levels
entries.createsprings.ponder.spring_sable.text_3: if spring is on sub level it pushes it
entries.createsprings.ponder.spring_sable.text_4: equal impulses will be applied to both sub levels
entries.createsprings.ponder.spring_sable.text_5: on sub levels spring can split and shoot blocks in front
entries.createsprings.ponder.spring_sable.text_6: if spring collides with enough speed it splashes
entries.createsprings.ponder.springsplash.header: Using rotational force stored in springs
entries.createsprings.ponder.springsplash.text_1: The spring mode can be switched by clicking on block with Tripwire Hook
entries.createsprings.ponder.springsplash.text_2: By clicking on spring with empty hand mode switches back
entries.createsprings.ponder.springsplash.text_3: In splash mode spring instantly releases stored energy on activation
entries.createsprings.ponder.springsplash.text_4: Springs are able to push entities...
entries.createsprings.ponder.springsplash.text_6: to break block spring needs enough charge
entries.createsprings.ponder.springsplash.text_7: springs do not break mechanisms and pressure plates
entries.createsprings.ponder.welding.text_1: friction welding is another way to process blocks
entries.createsprings.ponder.welding.text_2: when they rotate with enough speed and there is blocks between welders, welding will start
entries.createsprings.ponder.welding.text_3: Welding speed depends on the speed difference between welders
entries.item.createsprings.broken_portative_stea: _mechanism_ that has been subjected to _improper use_, despite the damage, _can be repaired_
entries.item.createsprings.hat.tooltip.summary: A _hat_. can be _placed_ on the ground and also can store _1 stack_ , if engineer _goggles_ are stacked on top it will function as engineer _goggles_
entries.item.createsprings.molten_spring_alloy_b: a viscous, hot liquid with a metallic color, strangely, it _doesn't harm_
entries.item.createsprings.portative_steam_engin: A small _Steam Engine_ capable of _charging_ tools, lighting the way, and also _warming_ and _accelerating_ players
entries.item.createsprings.punchcard.tooltip.sum: Can _program_ some tools, can hold a _small amount_ of commands
Incredibly _elastic_ material, resistant to _explosions_, has a low melting point, cannot be _compressed_ with a press
entries.item.createsprings.spring_base.tooltip.s: A Base for _spring-powered_ tools, can hold up to _2 springs_, to transform it into a spring tool stack a _modifier_ on top
A _spring-powered_ drill, Can hold up to _2 springs_ Mining _speed_ depends on the _tool's speed_
entries.item.createsprings.spring_fan.tooltip.su: A _portable_ spring-powered _Fan_, Can hold up to _2 springs_, pushes entities _to_ or _from_ the player, direction changes when _Shift_ is pressed, Works on _elytra_
entries.item.createsprings.spring_launcher.toolt: A _powerful_ weapon that can _fire springs_ or _spring alloy blocks_, scope can be added by _placing a spyglass_ inside
entries.item.createsprings.spring_saw.tooltip.su: A _spring-powered_ saw, Can hold up to _2 springs_ Harvesting _speed_ depends on the _tool's speed_
A _spring-powered_ shovel, Can hold up to _2 springs_ Harvesting _speed_ depends on the _tool's speed_
entries.item.createsprings.sus_package.tooltip.s: This package when _dropped_ from a height or _destroyed_, releases a _spring_ that bounces off _blocks_ or _entities_
